from.place: 09N5 proof, the reduction from semilocal Dedekind domains to the finite list of localizations at maximal ideals, which are discrete valuation rings

title: A semilocal Dedekind domain reduces to finitely many DVRs
statement: Let B be a semilocal Dedekind domain (a Noetherian integrally closed domain of Krull dimension 1 [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]) with fraction field K. The set of maximal ideals of B is finite, and replacing B by the finite family of localizations B_m at its maximal ideals produces discrete valuation rings [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] with fraction field K. An element of K lies in the Jacobson radical of B exactly when its image lies in the maximal ideal of every B_m.

source.place: Algebra Definition 034W and Lemma 034X (algebra-lemma-characterize-Dedekind), together with the localization description at maximal ideals used in Varieties Lemma 09N5
